reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one that names the lab and puts the batch report on the box. At $24.99 for the first box I'd try one, since the money-back guarantee means I'm not stuck with it.
objection: Made in China. I only believe the lab report if the lab is real and the batch number on my box really matches it.
would_change_my_mind: If I scanned the QR code and the report was missing, didn't match the batch number, or the lab turned out to be unknown.
